comment: Input 4 (CV 3) and outputs 4 and 5 are declared in the code but have no jack on the panel, so they are left untagged. The note-input polyphony is worked out as the smaller of the V/Oct channel count and the Gate OUTPUT channel count, which follows the Clock input, so a patch with fewer Clock channels than played notes reads fewer notes than are being played. The CV 3 input and the CV 3 output are configured on the panel but nothing in the installed v2.0.3 source reads or writes either of them.
